cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong remains the final band because Sodium Lauryl Sulfate is the position-2 primary cleanser with several secondary surfactant routes; ordinary rinse-off directions do not soften the formula-derived cleansing call.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Glyceryl Oleate, Glycol Distearate, Lecithin and cationic guar buffer the chassis enough to keep confidence moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate conditioning remains supported by mid-list refatting and deposition routes; honey/beeswax positioning corroborates a care story but cannot create visible beeswax formula evidence.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: The position-2 SLS chassis and no-silicone formula argue against high conditioning.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate weight potential remains formula-derived from refatting lipids and cationic guar, with strong sulfate reset preventing a high-weight conclusion.
weightPotential.counterSignal: No silicone or heavy butter/oil route appears, and SLS gives strong same-wash reset capacity.

weightAssessment.whyThisBand: Several mid-list refatting/deposition clues can plausibly leave bounded softness or residue, especially with cationic guar.
weightAssessment.whyNotNeighborBand: Low would ignore the combined lipid/polymer routes; high would overread a no-silicone, strong-cleansing formula.

focusPrimary.rationale: Repair is final because revealed positioning targets stressed, damaged-looking hair and the formula has compatible refatting, humectant and cationic-polymer care routes; confidence stays moderate because the beeswax claim is not visible in INCI.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: The product story names beeswax, but no beeswax INCI such as CERA ALBA is present; this keeps the repair read bounded.

focusSecondary.rationale: No secondary focus is retained because the revealed care positioning reuses the same honey/refatting/polymer route as the repair primary.
focusSecondary.counterSignal: No distinct shine, volume, scalp_active or clarifying claim has an independent route.

usageRole.rationale: Regular remains final because directions are normal wet-hair lather-and-rinse use and there is no treatment or explicit reset trigger.
usageRole.counterSignal: The strong cleanser chassis would support alternating only if reset/oily-root positioning were revealed.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted remains final because the revealed claims concern damaged-looking hair, not sensitive or uncomfortable scalp, and the formula has SLS/fragrance counter-signals.
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: Glycerin and honey can support hair feel, but no scalp-comfort intent is revealed.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported is mechanical: the complete INCI contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.
dandruffSupport.counterSignal: No revealed anti-dandruff positioning or recognized active changes the formula rule.

postUnblindDeltas.reason: Revealed positioning targets stressed, damaged-looking hair; the formula has compatible care routes, while the beeswax/INCI mismatch limits confidence.
